items.title: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) Ties Its Governance Tools To A New Tokenized Market
items.summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions (NYSE:BR) agreed to partner with the New York Stock Exchange to support NYSE's tokenized securities platform. The partnership will use Broadridge's on chain shareholder governance tools and digital transfer agency services for tokenized securities on NYSE's system.
